text.jp:
……いや、なんでもありません。
今言ったことは気にしないでください。
text.official_en: I...apologize for the rhetorical and inane question. Please, forget that I said anything.
text.real_en: ...No, it's nothing. Please forget I said anything.

text.jp:
あそこでの出来事をどう判断するかは、
レイン次第よ。
text.official_en: I’ll let you decide what to make of what you saw in there, Rain.

text.jp:
あっちの方のフィーナに会いたい？
わかったわ。
text.official_en: Oh, want to talk to the other Fina, do you? You got it.

text.jp:
あの精神世界は
私の記憶と感情から作られたものよ。
text.official_en: That world in my psyche was conjured from my memories and emotions.

text.jp: いえ、余計な感傷ね。忘れて。
text.official_en: Erm...I suppose I’m being overbearing. Forget what I said.
text.real_en: No, I'm just getting sentimental. Forget I said anything.

text.jp:
お前とラスウェルが立派になった姿を
あいつにも見せてやりたいんだ。
text.official_en: I’d like to show her how far our sons have come.
text.real_en: I want to show her what fine young men you and Lasswell have become.

text.jp:
けどよ、お前たちと一緒なら、
俺にもやれそうな気がするぜ。
ヒーローみたいにな。
text.official_en: But when I’m with you guys though, it feels like anything’s possible. Hell, I’m practically a hero.
text.real_en: But with you guys, I feel like I could do it. Like some kind of hero.

text.jp:
ここまでの強敵とは私も戦ったことがないわ。
でも、大丈夫。
今の私は一人じゃないから。
text.official_en: Even <text style="italic">I</> have never fought such an uphill battle. But I am not alone anymore. I am not worried in the slightest.
text.real_en: Even I've never faced an enemy this strong before. But it's all right. I'm not alone anymore.

text.jp: じゃ、チェンジ！
text.official_en: It’s morphing time!
text.real_en: Then, switch!

text.jp:
すべてが終わったら
一緒にソフィアの墓参りにいこう。
text.official_en: When everything is over, let’s go visit your mother’s grave with Lasswell.
text.real_en: When this is all over, let's visit Sophia's grave together.

text.jp:
そういえば、スニウ村で掲示板を見た時
少し気がかりに思った記事があったんです。
text.official_en: I happen to remember something...
text.real_en: Come to think of it, when I saw the noticeboard in Sunioo, there was an article that concerned me.

text.jp:
そのことを知ってしまった以上、
私には水華を憎むことはできません……。
text.official_en: As long as this truth stands, I cannot harbor disdain for Alluvion any longer.
text.real_en: Knowing that, I can't hate Water Bloom Veritas anymore...

text.jp: それをふと思い出しまして……
text.official_en: I noticed a peculiar article on the noticeboard when we were in Sunioo.
text.real_en: I just happened to remember it...

text.jp:
ただ、レインが生まれ育った街を
一緒に見てみたいな……なんて、思ったら駄目かしら……
text.official_en: I would like to tour the city you grew up in—just the two of us...
text.real_en: I was just thinking I'd like to see the city where you grew up, Rain... together with you. Is that so wrong...?

text.jp:
って感じでなんとかなればいいんだけど……。
そうもいかないのよね。
text.official_en: ...would be what I’d say before I change into her, were it that easy. You’re stuck with little old me for now.
text.real_en: If only it were that easy... But it doesn't work that way.

text.jp: とうとうここまできたな。
text.official_en: Well...here we are.
text.real_en: Well, we've finally made it this far.

text.jp: どんどん増えていくのもありなんじゃないか！？
text.official_en: The more the merrier—am I right, or am I right!?
text.real_en: Why not keep adding more and more!?

text.jp: もうしばらくはここにお世話になってるわ。
text.official_en: I think I’d like to stay onboard your airship for a while longer.

text.jp:
もう一人のフィーナだけじゃなく、
もう二人のフィーナ、もう三人のフィーナって感じで……。
text.official_en: But that got me thinking. Maybe we can get another <text style="italic">other</> Fina on board. Or better yet, a couple additional Finas.
text.real_en: Not just another Fina, but two more Finas, even three more...

text.jp:
ジェイクは初対面の印象から、
いい加減な男と思っていましたが……。
そうではなかったようです。
text.official_en: When we first encountered Jake, I took him for a gormless churl...yet I was proven wrong.
text.real_en: When I first met Jake, I thought he was an irresponsible man... but I was wrong.

text.jp:
ゾルダードのことはシエラに任せた。
アメリアもついているからな。
何も心配しちゃいねえ。
text.official_en: Zoldaad’s future is with Shera now. And with Amelia also beside him, I know the country’s in good hands.
text.real_en: I left Zoldaad in Shera's hands. Amelia's with him, too, so I'm not worried.

text.jp:
レイン。
たまにはグランシェルトに戻らなくていいの？
text.official_en: Rain, don’t you wish to go back to Grandshelt once in a while?

text.jp:
レインには私がついているし
私にはレインがついているから。
text.official_en: Why? Because you have me...and I have you, Rain.

text.jp: 今、私が何を考えているかわかりますか？
text.official_en: Care to guess what is on my mind at the moment?

text.jp:
今のゾルダードがあるのもヴィルヘルム将軍の
その身を捧げた行動のおかげ……なのかもね。
text.official_en: It’s fair to say that without his selfless sacrifice, Zoldaad wouldn’t exist as it does now.
text.real_en: Maybe the Zoldaad we know today exists because General Wilhelm put his life on the line...

text.jp:
俺たちならやれる……。
いや、やらなきゃダメなんだ。世界のためにな。
text.official_en: We can do this... We <text style="italic">have</> to—for everyone in the world.

text.jp:
俺はゾルダードのためだけに戦ってきた。
だから、世界を守るなんて
ホントは柄じゃねえんだ。
text.official_en: Spent most of my time fighting for Zoldaad, so saving the whole world...? Yeah, it feels like I bit off a lot more than I can chew.
text.real_en: I've only ever fought for Zoldaad. So protecting the whole world isn't really my style.

text.jp:
六盟傑の目的を阻止すること……。
今はそれだけを考えましょう。
text.official_en: Let us concentrate on the task at hand: thwarting the Sworn Six.

text.jp:
初代の守り人である水華がいたから、
今のオルデリオンがあり、
私たちが生まれたのです。
text.official_en: Alluvion, the First Maiden, is the reason Olderion came to be...how <text style="italic">I</> came to be.
text.real_en: Because Water Bloom Veritas, the first Warden, was there, Olderion exists as it does today, and we were born.

text.jp: 別に心配しているわけじゃないけど……
text.official_en: Not that it is my business to tell you so. Although...
text.real_en: It's not that I'm worried, but...

text.jp:
単なる胸騒ぎならばよいのですが……
オルデリオンに寄ることがあったら
少し調査をしてみようと思います。
text.official_en: I trust it is but an unfounded concern. Nevertheless, should we find ourselves in Olderion, I would like to investigate the matter.

text.jp:
噂も当てにならないわね。
まさかあんなことが裏で起こっていたなんて。
text.official_en: Well, can’t believe everything you hear, I guess. I had no idea what was going on behind the scenes with General Wilhelm.
text.real_en: Rumors aren't always reliable. I never imagined something like that was going on behind the scenes.

text.jp:
女性陣が増えるってのは実にいいことだ。
そこで俺は思うんだ。
text.official_en: Gotta say, I’m lovin’ the fact we’ve got more ladies joining the crew.
text.real_en: It's great that there are more women joining us. And that got me thinking...

text.jp:
彼の国と弟への思いは本物……。
今は尊敬していますよ。
text.official_en: I’ve come to respect him now. His patriotism for his homeland and his love for his brother are genuine.
text.real_en: His feelings for his homeland and his younger brother are genuine... I respect him now.

text.jp: 心置きなくお前たちと戦えるぜ。
text.official_en: Which is exactly why I can fight alongside you guys without losing a wink of sleep.
text.real_en: Now I can fight alongside you without anything weighing on my mind.

text.jp:
最後の戦いが近づいているけど
なんの心配もしてないわ。
text.official_en: Our last fight grows ever closer, but I’ve not a worry in the world.

text.jp:
水華はこれからどんな形であれ、
自分の罪を償っていくことでしょう。
text.official_en: We have yet to see how, but Alluvion will spend the rest of her existence in penance.
text.real_en: From now on, Water Bloom Veritas will atone for her sins, in whatever way she can.

text.jp: 私の戦術でみなさんを必ず勝利に導いてみせます。
text.official_en: My strategist’s mind shall lead everyone to victory. I promise.
text.real_en: I'll use my strategies to lead all of you to victory. I promise.

text.jp:
私はもうそれ以上のことを水華には望みません。
きっとエルもわかってくれるはずです。
text.official_en: I wish for nothing more from her. I believe El would also agree with my sentiment.
text.real_en: I don't ask anything more of Water Bloom Veritas. I'm sure El will understand, too.

text.jp:
起こったことは全て事実だけど
主観的に再現されたところもあるかもね。
text.official_en: What happened within were true events, but only as I saw it. My mind may have...colored a few things along the way.
text.real_en: Everything that happened was real, though some parts might have been recreated from my own point of view.

text.jp:
魔列車で拾ったメモも
解読できないか引き続き調べるわ。
text.official_en: Although, I still need to get that memo I picked up on the train decoded. I’ll keep looking into it.

text.jp:
魔列車の正体もわかって一安心。
しばらくはここに居候させてもらうわね。
text.official_en: Glad we got that Phantom Train business squared away. I’m going to stay here on your airship for a while—if you don’t mind, that is.
